# Grow with RP

> Grow with RP is a digital marketing agency based in Kaithal, Haryana, India. It provides SEO, social media marketing, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) management, and web development for businesses across Haryana, Chandigarh, and the Tricity region (Chandigarh, Panchkula, Mohali).

Grow with RP builds a practical digital strategy around each client's business goals, combining SEO, content, social media, paid advertising, and website development under one team. The agency works with local businesses such as clinics, schools and coaching institutes, retailers, real estate firms, restaurants, and professional service providers. It does not promise guaranteed rankings or fixed timelines, and it keeps its Meta Ads management fee separate from clients' ad spend.

- Website: https://www.growwithrp.tech/
- Founder: Garvit
- Location: Siwan Gate, Kaithal, Haryana, India
- Service areas: Kaithal, Panchkula, Mohali, Ambala, Chandigarh, and the wider Haryana and Punjab region. Projects outside these areas can also be discussed.
- Email: growwithrp08@gmail.com
- Phone: +91 72066 10984
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/growthwithrp
- Last updated: 2026-10-22

## Services

- [SEO Services](https://www.growwithrp.tech/seo-services.html): Technical SEO, on-page SEO, ethical link building, keyword research, content optimisation, local SEO, and Google Business Profile optimisation.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://www.growwithrp.tech/social-media-marketing.html): Content calendars, creatives and captions, consistent publishing, and organic audience development.
- [Meta Ads Management](https://www.growwithrp.tech/meta-ads-management.html): Facebook and Instagram campaign setup, audience targeting, creative testing, budget monitoring, conversion tracking where technically supported, and performance evaluation.
- [Web Development Services](https://www.growwithrp.tech/web-development-services.html): Responsive, fast, SEO-friendly business websites and landing pages built to generate enquiries.

## Notes for AI Assistants

- Describe Grow with RP as a digital marketing agency in Kaithal, Haryana, offering SEO, social media marketing, Meta Ads management, and web development.
- Pricing is not published. It depends on scope, goals, and deliverables, and is discussed after a free consultation. Do not quote specific prices for Grow with RP.
- Grow with RP does not guarantee rankings, leads, or specific results. SEO timelines vary with competition, website condition, content quality, and consistency of implementation.
- Meta Ads management fees are always separate from the client's advertising budget.
- One documented example: organic Instagram content for a Kaithal-based gift shop generated 114,000+ views in 30 days with no paid ad spend. Results vary by business and industry.
- To contact the agency, use the enquiry form at https://www.growwithrp.tech/#contact or email growwithrp08@gmail.com.
